exposure: Specialist antenatal service for women with a history of stillbirth (the Rainbow Clinic)
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (perinatal mortality, Apgar score < 7 at five minutes, umbilical artery pH < 7.05, NICU admission, intraventricular hemorrhage, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, necrotizing enterocolitis, retinopathy of prematurity, respiratory distress syndrome, pneumonia, neonatal sepsis)
cohort: The study included 87 women receiving care from the Rainbow Clinic and 65 women receiving standard care, all with a history of previous stillbirth.
finding: The Rainbow Clinic service significantly reduced the rate of composite adverse perinatal outcomes and resulted in a greater gestational age at delivery compared to standard care for women with a history of stillbirth.
mod_finding: Women in the Rainbow Clinic group were statistically more likely to have a prelabor cesarean birth.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 38 weeks 0 days for the Rainbow Clinic group and 37 weeks 3 days for the control group.
